summary.text: Roxtec develops, manufactures and delivers modular sealing solutions and associated services for cable and pipe penetrations, and supplies related design software and documentation. The company sells to a wide range of industries (infrastructure, manufacturing, marine, offshore oil & gas, power and process industries), maintains a global presence with headquarters in Karlskrona, Sweden, and offers installation training, supervision and certified transit inspections.
